welcomeDesc:
If you run a product or service,
you've probably wondered this before.
managerPainTitle: Managers have it just as hard
managerPainDesc:
Are customer requests being handled on time?
Can you trust the status reports you're getting?
No way to verify — you just have to take their word.
workerPainTitle: If you're on the ground, you know
workerPainDesc:
Code handed over with no context.
Requests piling up, deadlines closing in, not enough people.
And on top of it all, you still have to write status reports.
execPainDesc:
How much are you spending on this product?
Where are the most resources going?
Can you see ROI — in actual numbers?
solutionDesc:
AI fixes the code and delivers the results.
Every step and cost is recorded in real-time.
No need to ask, report, or estimate.
projectDesc:
Sign in with GitHub/GitLab via OAuth
and import all your projects at once.
No complex setup needed.
agentDesc:
Register AI agents like Claude or Gemini,
assign them to your projects, and you're set.
startDesc:
Create one directly in IVE,
or just add a label in Git — auto-detected.
AI takes it from there.
conclusionDesc:
AI-powered project management
for teams that run products and services.

Developers focus on work. Managers on visibility.
Executives on decisions.
